reuse.why: All month-wide actions reuse getBulkBudgetCategories, and the new action also uses the existing sign conversion, spreadsheet, batching, and budget-writing helpers.

duplication.why: The exclusion rules remain centralized, with no duplicated selection or sign-conversion logic.

placement.why: Budget policy remains in actions.ts and method registration follows the existing app.ts layering.

scope.why: The edits are limited to the requested bulk-action changes, their registration, a focused test, and release notes.

maintainability.why: One shared selector owns the exclusions, callers forward the hidden-category option directly, and the existing missing-group variation remains explicit.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories adds saved-template and #fixed-group exclusion branches; includeHiddenCategories replaces the existing includeHidden parameter, and every bulk caller continues using the selector.
